_comment: Per-file ceiling for raw `database.execute*` / `database.upsert` calls in `src/lifecycle/ipc-handlers/**`. Enforced by `tests/integration/ipc-handlers-no-raw-sql.test.ts` (ADR-0007 Final PR). Adding a NEW violation to an existing file OR adding a NEW file with violations fails the test. Removing violations decrements the ceiling — once at zero, the file is fully migrated; remove its entry to lock that file's clean state forever.
_audit: Snapshot from .cache/generate-ceiling.js on 2026-05-28. The migration train has now fully migrated EVERY IPC handler off raw SQL — `paths` is empty (2026-06-01, syncHandlers was the last). With an empty allow-list the enforcement test is an effective hard-zero gate: any `database.execute*` / `upsert` in `src/lifecycle/ipc-handlers/**` fails it. Follow-up: simplify `tests/integration/ipc-handlers-no-raw-sql.test.ts` to a plain zero-violations assertion and retire this file. See ADR-0007 in docs/adr/.
